intro_blocks.text: In this lesson you will have to mentally rotate an object about one of the three principle axes.

intro_blocks.alt_text: box shape with given rotation as 270° about the z-axis
first step is a rotation 90° about the z axis
second step is a 2nd 90° rotation about the z axis making it 180°
third step is a 3rd 90° rotation about the z axis making it 270°
the final figure is drawn as the solution

content_description:
The object is rotated about the axis shown. Use the reference dot to draw the rotated object.
Note the direction and degrees of rotation. Counterclockwise is designated as a positive direction of rotation.
